crossRefs.note: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious…
She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of…
She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of…
They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
“The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place…

translations.web: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
translations.bsb: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
translations.kjv: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
translations.asv: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.
